name: VERIFY_HYPERFLOW_FRESH
short_summary: Reads Facebook DMs, extracts URLs (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram), collects metadata and stores it in a Google Sheet.

name: YouTube Cron Job
short_summary: Fetches a list of YouTube channel IDs, extracts videos from the past 3 days, gathers metadata into a Google Sheet, and emails a daily summary.

name: Webform Submission Automation
short_summary: Fetches webform URLs and field data, fills and submits forms automatically using Browserless.

name: Typeform Submission Automation
short_summary: Fetches Typeform URLs and field data, fills and submits Typeform forms automatically using Browserless.

name: Instagram Automatic Comments Generator
short_summary: Triggers on comments for a specific user, filters spam/flagged comments, generates appropriate replies using vector data, and posts replies via the Facebook Graph API.

name: Asana Task Automatic Scheduler
short_summary: Triggers on Slack messages and generates Asana tasks using pre-existing blueprints.

name: Events Embedder
short_summary: Runs every 1-3 hours, fetches new events, stores them in Supabase, and generates embedding vectors for each new event.

name: Selly Vector Store
short_summary: Runs weekly to fetch new rows, store them in Supabase, and generate embedding vectors for each row.

name: Dana Dairy AI Chatbot
short_summary: On incoming messages, discovers relevant providers via Apify actors, extracts information, stores it in a Google Sheet, and generates context-aware replies.
